posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
Yes, if you found the right photochromic for your beam power it would work. You can get gausian distribution filters. I have seen them, I think they are called "bulls eye" gradient filters. Both ideas are very wasteful of light.

But, if you think about it, we are spreading the beam anyways so if we used a linse that spread the middle more than the edges it would start to even out the beam profile. I am not up for grinding an aspheric lens however making an HOE...
